name: Seat Selection
description: Choosing seats per flight and passenger: segment tabs, passenger selector, legend with prices, seat map and selection panel, with a list-view alternative.

provenance.tag: Split screen and mobile overlay: A · unverified. Seat types: Official. Per-segment tabs, legend-first, preview/confirm, list view: Rec (D17, D18).

structure:
[Segment tabs — one per flight: DXB → MXP | MXP → JFK | JFK → DXB]
[Passenger selector: whose seat]
[SeatLegend: types with glyphs + price range for this passenger · "List view" toggle]
[SeatMap — cabin grid]                 [Selection panel: seat, type, position, price, Confirm seat]   ← lg+: split screen (A)

regions.name: Segment tabs
regions.description: One tab per physical flight (not per journey). Each tab shows its progress ("2 of 3 seats").

regions.name: SeatLegend
regions.description: Types with glyphs + price range for this passenger, and a "List view" toggle. Sits above the map.

regions.name: SeatMap + selection panel
regions.description: Cabin grid; selection panel shows seat, type, position, price and Confirm seat.

responsive.behavior: The seat map is a full-screen overlay and the selection panel is a bottom sheet.

rules: Seat configurations by aircraft (A · unverified): A380 Economy 3-4-3; 777 Business 1-2-1 or 2-3-2; A380 First 1-1-1.
Seat types (Official): Regular, Preferred, Twin, Extra Legroom.
The seat map is drawn from aircraft configuration data; seat layouts are never hardcoded.
Tap previews a seat; Confirm seat commits it (SELECT_SEAT, server first). A seat conflict keeps the passenger's previous seat and shows a message.
Prices come from the seat-map API per passenger; never shown only on hover; never computed on the client.
